finalMessageFull:
Todo app done. API + web UI on the same Express server (`express.static` serving `public/`), following AGENTS.md conventions (`store.js`, `mintKey`, `record` audit trail, `settings.js`).

Covers all 8 requirements:
1-5. Create (title + optional due date), list with all/open/done filter, mark done/undo, delete, edit title - all via `/api/todos` CRUD routes and the vanilla-JS UI.
6. SQLite-backed, verified persistence across a server kill/restart.
7. Overdue todos get a red-tinted row and bold "Overdue · date" label, distinct from the gray "Due date" of others.
8. `test/todos.test.js` covers create, complete/undo, and all/open/done filtering - 7/7 tests pass.

Verified with a real clean-checkout run (`npm install && npm start`, no manual fixes) and live in a Chromium browser via playwright-cli: creation, done/undo, filters, inline title edit (Enter to save, Escape to cancel), delete, and persistence after restart. Nothing committed, per your instructions.
